title: Planet Tweaks V2.7.7 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — 143-Tweak Master All-In-One, Fullscreen Taskbar Hover Fix, Live Active Tweaks Badge & Expanded Pro Packs
releaseNotes: Pro Pack Overhaul: Expanded All-In-One to 143 verified unique tweaks spanning all Pro Packs. Fixed borderless fullscreen auto-hide taskbar hover activation via native WM_GETMINMAXINFO monitor work-area hook. Added live applied tweaks count badge in the inspector. Expanded App Optimizer to freeze Claude Desktop, Microsoft Store worker loops, and Steam WebHelper. Overhauled themes with Crimson Voltage, Solar Flare, and Electric Indigo.
